name: Oral transmission and shared memory
requirements: Accessible narrators/listeners and teaching time
behavior: Preserves skills, place names, experience; consumes time and has limited reach/copying

name: Kin mutual aid and care obligations
requirements: Actual carers, dependents, distributable provision
behavior: Redeemable care/assistance; may displace labor or favor kin

name: Temporary task leadership

behavior: Limited migration/hunting/construction authority; return powers as agreed after the task, no unlimited renewal

name: Shared food storage and distribution
requirements: Storable food, custodians, explicit withdrawal rights
behavior: Shares shortages among participants; spoilage, guarding, allocation disputes remain

name: Demonstration apprenticeships
requirements: Practitioners, tools, learner time
behavior: Expands specific skills; instructors cannot teach unknown knowledge

name: Seasonal cooperation calendars

behavior: Coordinates farming, migration, maintenance; wrong records cause timing errors, not culture points

name: Common land use

behavior: Rotation, gathering, grazing, recovery; boundaries and monitoring consume resources

name: Water-management deliberation
requirements: Workable farmland, water, actual irrigation structures
behavior: Allocates maintenance and water sequence; real upstream/downstream conflict

name: Household inheritance and property responsibility

behavior: Intergenerational investment/maintenance; may concentrate assets or exclude nonheirs

name: Mutual-aid granaries and disaster obligations
requirements: Real storage, shares, accounts, executors
behavior: Rule-based assistance; withdrawal requires actual food, no unlimited promise

name: Witnessed commitments and dispute mediation
requirements: Accessible witnesses, parties, limited enforcement
behavior: Oral/material commitments support early contracts; no universal risk-free arbitration

name: Visitor reception and passage customs
requirements: Reachable outside groups, reception supplies, security
behavior: Limited trade/learning contact; no automatic membership, property, or trust

name: Recordkeeping offices and public archives
requirements: Checkable recording, recorders, durable media
behavior: Accounts, duties, cases survive individuals; offices can be monopolized

name: Religious relief and teaching organizations
requirements: An actually founded fictional religion, participants, lawful provision, doctrinal permission
behavior: Actual adherent relief/teaching; may limit recipients or curricula

name: Local public mutual aid
requirements: Members beyond one household, common rules, real provision
behavior: Mutual aid without formal religion; recruitment, supervision, finance cost resources

name: Rotating defense and service obligations
requirements: Weapons, eligible members, supplies, rolls
behavior: Allocates defense and labor withdrawal; arrears, exemptions, coercion affect participation

name: Transferable land-use contracts
requirements: Enforceable boundaries, terms, rental/dispute records
behavior: Leasing/improvement; transfers existing rights, creates no land

name: Craft guilds and qualification transmission
requirements: Concentrated craft/product demand, experts, training spaces
behavior: Quality/apprenticeships; entry/transmission restrictions may become exclusion

name: Urban public affairs
requirements: Stable settlements, surplus, housing/water/sanitation staff
behavior: Extends maintenance duties to towns; waterworks or mutual aid can supply experience; titles create no output

name: Written adjudication and procedure
requirements: Stable records, intelligible rules, adjudicators/executors
behavior: Predictable procedures; powerful actors may still control interpretation/access/enforcement

name: Merchant arbitration and escrow
requirements: Real trades, accessible custody, assets, acceptance capacity
behavior: Cross-organization delivery; custody consumes space/staff and can fail in war or isolation

name: Joint ventures and revenue accounts
requirements: Accumulable assets, measurement, accounts, enforceable distribution
behavior: Pools existing cash/goods, no automatic bank-credit creation; losses follow rights

name: Curricula and sustained schools
requirements: Qualified teachers, reliable texts/teaching records, student support, lasting site
behavior: Repeatable teaching; a small school is not mass education; advanced courses need knowledge/practice

name: Translation and interregional archives
requirements: Actual knowledge, translators, transport/communication, copying
behavior: Broader sources; translation error, rights, custody costs persist

name: Task examinations and professional qualifications
requirements: Testable jobs, examiners, equipment, available roles
behavior: Capability-based selection; exams can be monopolized, certificates do not replace current ability

name: Specialized administration and budget records
requirements: Continuing taxes/in-kind supply, qualified staff, communication, responsibilities
behavior: Local/central functions; collection, statistics, audit, coordination consume hours

name: Scholarly patronage and specialist colleges
requirements: Surplus, teachers/scholars, records, research instruments
behavior: Public/joint sponsorship supports study; sponsors may constrain topics, colleges do not automatically know science

name: Public argument and peer criticism
requirements: Records, communication, supported discussants, actual space for dissent
behavior: Colleges, schools, or craft exchange formulate questions; argument cannot replace measurement

name: Reproducible-evidence communities
requirements: Comparisons, quantitative measurement, reproducible science, independent samples/teams
behavior: Shares failures and replication, consumes experiment budgets, cannot vote physical laws into being

name: Cross-craft technical exchange
requirements: Contacting craftspeople, demonstration equipment, document/teaching rights
behavior: Combines specialties; may weaken monopoly and needs compensation/confidentiality

name: Bounded technology licenses and result rights
requirements: Defined delivery, existing lawful rights, acceptance/enforcement
behavior: Separately trades rights, drawings, teaching, guarantees; licenses cannot erase memory

name: Public basic education
requirements: Teacher reproduction, inexpensive materials, child/adult time, support, sustainable finance
behavior: Broadens foundational skills; a law cannot graduate everyone or require uniform belief

name: Industrial employment and labor contracts
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Sustainable plants, wage labor, cash/in-kind pay, jobs, exit conditions
behavior: Public/joint institutions can employ at scale; pay, injury, care, unemployment affect households/factions

name: Labor representation and collective bargaining
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Shared occupations, organizing channels, member support, bargaining rights
behavior: Negotiates pay/safety/hours; participants bear stoppage losses, no automatic output gain

name: Professional enterprise governance
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Productive capital, manager/owner rights, accounts, enforcement
behavior: Separates operation from investment; agency/conflicting authority costs remain

name: Public-service budgets and responsibility
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Sustainable revenue, facilities, acceptance, public or authorized checks
behavior: Continuing housing/sanitation/road obligations; promises need real spending capacity

name: Professional command and war responsibility

requirements: Qualified command, communication, training, supply, casualty/restraint records
behavior: Persistent orders/logistics/postwar responsibility; professionals still consume people/funding

name: Property registers and responsibility succession
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Real assets/control provenance, reliable records, enforcement
behavior: Collateral, inheritance, mergers, bankruptcy; registering unknown assets creates no control

name: Basic-provision responsibility and risk sharing
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Actual food/water/care/funding, eligible recipients, sharing rules
behavior: Reduces some household volatility and supports study; promised welfare is not delivered service

name: Bounded public power and independent review
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Authority documents, relatively independent reviewers, enforceable correction/appeal
behavior: Limits commands and assigns responsibility; takes time and guarantees no correct vote

name: Hierarchical appointment and inspection
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Appointment chain, inspection records, rotation, removal/correction powers
behavior: Coordinates large projects; filtering and superior mistakes need actual review

name: Multilevel autonomy and federal contracts
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Members, reserved powers, shared budget/security, enactment process
behavior: Delegated government; negotiation takes time and does not share all private assets

name: Standing inter-polity dispute arrangements
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Recognized parties, communication, adjudication, credible security
behavior: Reduces some conflict/performance risk; without enforcement it is only a claim

name: Research commons and specialization networks
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Labs, talent, funding, shareable results, license limits
behavior: Shared data and divided replication; free riding, attribution, dependence enter contracts

name: Hazardous-engineering review and responsibility
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Measurable risk, independent inspectors, stop-work rights, incident supply, compensation
behavior: Civil or command-based review supports high-energy/nuclear/life-support work; costs/delay, no zero-risk promise

name: Lifelong training and transition support
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Updated courses, teachers, practice jobs, learner provision
behavior: Supports conversion; preserves old skills/opportunity costs, no monthly recreation of labor

name: Accountable data use and exchange
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Networks, identity/access records, data authority, measurement, appeal
behavior: Corporate or public arrangements define collection/use/transfer/liability; algorithms cannot fill missing truth

name: Corporate network jurisdictions
group: Industry, public governance, and computational society
requirements: Corporate infrastructure, chartered governance/service rights, residents, employment
behavior: Corporate service/access control may coordinate or entrench rent seeking; no automatic national cyberpunk

name: Verifiable algorithmic advisers
requirements: Validated models, authorized data, inference compute, human review, error records
behavior: Bounded advice; government retains authority, advice is not truth

name: Bounded algorithmic administration
requirements: Auditable computing, scope, shutdown/degradation, authority
behavior: Delegated scheduling/review; data errors, outages, maintenance, appeal remain costly

name: Reserved human powers and technical restraint
requirements: Executable human review/alternative jobs, boundaries, recovery
behavior: Retains human paths; not free immunity, and prohibited services cannot still be secretly enjoyed

name: Shared operation of network infrastructure
requirements: Ownership/operating rights, contributors, technicians, common procedures
behavior: Community/public/cooperative operation still needs coordination, maintenance, capital

name: AI-led highest administration
requirements: High-autonomy infrastructure, lawful highest authority, independent audit, actual handover, energy/maintenance
behavior: Hierarchical or bounded institutions may authorize AI; continuing performance, no consciousness assumption or automatic victory

name: Augmented-person qualifications and membership
requirements: Actual augmentation/medicine, safety, identity, responsibility
behavior: Governs access and qualifications; laws create no devices and unaugmented people do not automatically lose rights

name: Ecological cycles and resource responsibility
requirements: Measurable cycles, farm/industry cooperation, maintenance, damage responsibility
behavior: Land, recycling, life provision as continuing duties; cycles still use energy and incur losses

name: Intergenerational engineering commitments
requirements: Asset/duty records, sustainable finance, maintenance succession, revision
behavior: Supports long projects; cannot bind all future choices or erase debt through regime change

name: Authority under delayed communication
requirements: Measured delay, local executors, scope, lost-contact/acknowledgment procedures
behavior: Bounded remote autonomy; central commands must arrive; internal delegation can develop this independently

name: Habitat life-support contracts
requirements: Actual vulnerable/closed habitats, training, reserves, maintenance, emergency powers
behavior: Air/water/energy/evacuation duties; nationality cannot exclude residents from already assumed provision

name: Nonbiological-subject recognition plans
requirements: Verifiable identity continuity, capability/liability review; actual subjects and lawful process for rights
behavior: Prepares for possible machine/unknown subjects; no claim of established AI consciousness or foreknowledge of aliens

name: Recoverable civilization archives
requirements: Distributed redundancy, lasting media, intelligible codes, drills, maintainers
behavior: Preserves knowledge/rights/incidents; copied files do not copy people, skills, or independent evidence

name: Constitutional global community
requirements: Actual administrative/budget/security/adjudication authority and service over required polities/residents
behavior: Multilevel global duties; disputes/exit follow a real charter, signatures alone do not integrate

name: Negotiated standing global institutions
requirements: Actually delegated final adjudication/common security, finance, executors
behavior: Broad local autonomy with highest duties; unresolved vetoes or independent foreign-war powers cannot count as integration

name: Globally unified command governance
requirements: Services for all residents, succession, correction/appeal, real command coverage
behavior: Conquest or amalgamation can establish it; occupation does not replace civil service or sustained compliance costs

name: Common mission charter across sites
requirements: Remote facilities/tasks, valid delegation, burden sharing, lasting maintenance
behavior: Exploration/resources/hazards/lost-contact responsibilities; declarations cannot erase knowledge or existing liabilities
